market.license.loadable.label: Installable
market.license.loadable.notice: Permissive license (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause / CC0-1.0 / Unlicense): installable, bundled with the license text and upstream attribution.
market.license.viewOnly.label: View only
market.license.viewOnly.notice: License tier disallows installation (NOASSERTION / custom terms / AGPL-3.0 / no license / archived): browsable and traceable, not installable.
market.license.blocked.label: Blocked
market.license.blocked.notice: License forbids redistribution, asset yanked, or brand-derived risk: excluded from the market list.
market.install.viewOnlyReason: License tier disallows installation: source, license text and scores remain readable.
market.install.blockedReason: License forbids redistribution / yanked / brand-derived risk.
market.capability.promptInject.label: Inject prompt
market.capability.promptInject.scope: Granted by default: injects instructions only, no side effects.
market.capability.fsRead.label: Read project files
market.capability.fsRead.scope: Project working directory only (path normalization + escape detection).
market.capability.fsWrite.label: Write project files
market.capability.fsWrite.scope: Project working directory only (dryRun preview before writing).
market.capability.mcp.label: Call MCP tools
market.capability.subprocess.label: Spawn subprocess
market.capability.subprocess.scope: Denied by default: requires explicit approval on the install confirmation bar, audited per call.
market.capability.bash.label: Run shell commands
market.capability.bash.scope: Denied by default: requires explicit approval on the install confirmation bar, audited per call.
market.capability.network.label: Network access
market.capability.connector.label: Connector call
market.capability.connector.scope: Requires a declared domain allowlist; credentials stay in the local vault.
market.capability.comfyGenerate.label: Local image generation
market.capability.comfyGenerate.scope: Loopback address only, template parameters only.
market.capability.llmCall.label: LLM call
market.capability.llmCall.scope: Via the adapter layer (DeepSeek by default) + budget gate.
market.capability.unknown.scope: Capability outside the lexicon: requires explicit approval (never optimistic).
